segments.text: Clean, or replace the lens protector.
If the laser power decreases and the welding spark weakens, the welding head's lens protector
may get dirty or damaged.
Clean or replace it as needed.
Please clean or replace the lens protector in a dust-free or relatively clean environment.
Before operations, clean the welding head with lint-free paper or lint-free cloth and
wash your hands or wear lint-free gloves.
Remove the cover on the top of the welding head.
Remove the lens protector one.
Check the lens protector.
If the lens protector is dirty, use a cotton swab dipped with alcohol to clean it.
Then install it back to the welding head.
If the lens protector is burned or heavily dirty and uncleanable, it needs to be replaced.
Keep your hands clean or wear lint-free gloves to remove the gasket and lens protector.
Take out a new lens protector.
Do not touch the glass with your fingers or other tools during replacement to prevent dirt.
If the glass accidentally gets dirty or dusty, use a cotton swab to clean it.
Remove the protective film on the top.
Install the lens protector.
Remove the protective film on the other side.
Install the gasket back.
Install the lens protector back to the welding head.
Install the lens protector in the correct direction and press it into place.
